title: Factored form & writing equations交点式与求解析式

quiz.q: Which equation has x-intercepts −4 and 3?哪个方程的 x 截距是 −4 和 3？
opts: y=(x−4)(x+3)
y=2(x+4)(x−3)
y=(x+4)(x+3)
y=−(x−4)(x−3)
quiz.hint: Intercept −4 comes from the factor (x+4).截距 −4 对应因式 (x+4)。
quiz.ans: y=2(x+4)(x−3)
quiz.why: (x+4)=0⇒x=−4; (x−3)=0⇒x=3. The 2 does not change the zeros.(x+4)=0⇒x=−4；(x−3)=0⇒x=3。前面的 2 不影响零点。

quiz.q: Find the equation of the parabola with x-intercepts 0 and 6 passing through (2,16).求 x 截距为 0 和 6、经过 (2,16) 的抛物线方程。
quiz.hint: 16=a(2)(2−6)
quiz.ans: y=−2x(x−6)
quiz.why: 16=−8a⇒a=−2, so y=−2x(x−6).16=−8a⇒a=−2，所以 y=−2x(x−6)。

quiz.q: A parabola touches the x-axis only at x=3 and passes through (1,8). Find its equation.一条抛物线只在 x=3 处碰到 x 轴，并经过 (1,8)。求它的方程。
quiz.hint: Double root: y=a(x−3)2.重根：y=a(x−3)2。
quiz.ans: y=2(x−3)2
quiz.why: 8=a(1−3)2=4a⇒a=2.8=a(1−3)2=4a⇒a=2。

quiz.q: A parabola has x-intercepts −3 and 5 and a minimum value of −8. Find its equation in standard form.一条抛物线的 x 截距为 −3 和 5，最小值为 −8。求它的一般式。
quiz.hint: The vertex is at x=1, height −8.顶点在 x=1，高度 −8。
quiz.ans: y=21​x2−x−215​
quiz.why: −8=a(1+3)(1−5)=−16a⇒a=21​.−8=a(1+3)(1−5)=−16a⇒a=21​。

quiz.q: A soccer ball is kicked from the ground and lands 40 m away. At 10 m from the kick it is 6 m high. Using factored form with the kick at x=0, find the maximum height.足球从地面踢出，落在 40 m 外。离踢球点 10 m 处球高 6 m。以踢球点为 x=0，用交点式求最大高度。
quiz.hint: y=ax(x−40); the top is at x=20.y=ax(x−40)；最高点在 x=20。
quiz.why: 6=a(10)(−30)⇒a=−501​.6=a(10)(−30)⇒a=−501​。
